g.text: C7: decouple U7 pin 20 to pin 10 with short connections.

g.desc: C7: decouple U7 pin 20 to pin 10 with short connections.

g.text: 1.5k sets roughly 2mA per red LED, depending on VF and U7 output voltage.

g.desc: 1.5k sets roughly 2mA per red LED, depending on VF and U7 output voltage.

g.text: LEVEL_1 ... LEVEL_7 also feed encoder inputs I7 ... I1.

g.desc: LEVEL_1 ... LEVEL_7 also feed encoder inputs I7 ... I1.

g.text: XEMACS | 5V logic; TL431 shunt reference supplies the sensor and resistor ladder.

g.desc: XEMACS | 5V logic; TL431 shunt reference supplies the sensor and resistor ladder.

g.text: R17-R24: 2.2k comparator pull-ups. R25-R27: 10k hold U4 LT, BI/RBO and RBI HIGH.

g.desc: R17-R24: 2.2k comparator pull-ups. R25-R27: 10k hold U4 LT, BI/RBO and RBI HIGH.

g.text: U6 symbol: 1 REF, 2 A (GND), 3 K; REF and K tied to VREF. R35: 470 from 5V. Verify physical pinout.

g.desc: U6 symbol: 1 REF, 2 A (GND), 3 K; REF and K tied to VREF. R35: 470 from 5V. Verify physical pinout.

g.text: RV1: 2k (202). Keep enough LDR + RV1 resistance for TL431 bias; check the full adjustment range.

g.desc: RV1: 2k (202). Keep enough LDR + RV1 resistance for TL431 bias; check the full adjustment range.

g.text: C5/C6 from the former LDO are removed. Check TL431 stability before adding reference-rail capacitance.

g.desc: C5/C6 from the former LDO are removed. Check TL431 stability before adding reference-rail capacitance.

g.text: Core ICs, display, ladder and controls: THT. Support R/C: 0805; U7 and level LEDs: SMT.

g.desc: Core ICs, display, ladder and controls: THT. Support R/C: 0805; U7 and level LEDs: SMT.

g.text: Unfabricated design draft. LED levels indicate voltage thresholds; ambient lux is not calibrated.

g.desc: Unfabricated design draft. LED levels indicate voltage thresholds; ambient lux is not calibrated.

g.text: U7 isolates the LM339 outputs from LED current.

g.desc: U7 isolates the LM339 outputs from LED current.

g.text: HIGH = threshold crossed; LEDs accumulate from D1 to D7.

g.desc: HIGH = threshold crossed; LEDs accumulate from D1 to D7.

g.text: Both output enables are LOW. Unused input is grounded.

g.desc: Both output enables are LOW. Unused input is grounded.
